This rowing boat has just left the Blue Grotto. The rower of the boat in the background is about to pay for his passengers at the floating cash desk before entering the Grotto. 

Photographed by myself (Adrian Pingstone) in June 2007 and placed in the public domain.

images.filename: Entrance the the Blue Grotto IMG 0195.JPG
images.caption: The Blue Grotto (Italian: Grotta Azzurra) is a sea cave on the coast of the island of Capri, southern Italy. Sunlight, passing through an underwater cavity and shining through the seawater, creates a blue reflection that illuminates the cavern. The cave extends some 50 metres into the cliff at the surface, and is about 150 metres (490 ft) deep.
